Synopsis:
A multi-topic live blog covering: (1) The Ceuta migration crisis — up to 80,000 crossings, 3,000–5,000 migrants still present, ~100 deaths, EU-Morocco relations under strain; (2) Lithuania warning of potential Russian false flag provocations in the Baltic region; (3) A Leipzig airport drone incident involving a plane carrying military ammunition from France; (4) **Energy emergency measures in Hungary and Romania** — Hungary shutting non-essential lighting and partially shutting its sole nuclear plant due to record-low Danube water levels; Romania dimming street lighting and pre-authorising industrial power limits; (5) Ukraine developing domestic anti-ballistic missile capabilities.
